question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the Kerr parametric oscillator (Kerr-cat qubit) carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Goto, Sci. Rep. 6, 21686 (2016); Puri et al., npj Quantum Inf. 3, 18 (2017); Grimm et al., Nature 584, 205 (2020)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: Kerr parametric oscillator (Kerr-cat qubit)

carrier.name: quadratures x, y of the mode amplitude alpha = x + i y

closure: loss kappa = 1 into a zero-temperature bath; the vacuum noise of the loss enters as D = kappa/8 per quadrature (truncated Wigner)
observable: sign of the quadrature x (which of the two cat states)
assumptions: single mode, rotating frame of the pump
Kerr and loss as in Grimm et al., Nature 584, 205 (2020), scaled to kappa = 1
